summary: The test suite covers core library functions (parsing, classification, reporting) reasonably well but has critical gaps: (1) the main() CLI function is completely untested despite being the entry point used by the required GitHub Actions workflow; (2) the GitHub Actions workflow file itself is missing entirely, and all workflow-related requirements (actionlint validation, act execution, exit code verification, workflow structure tests) are unmet — this violates the task requirement that 'ALL TESTS MUST RUN THROUGH ACT'; (3) edge cases in requirements.txt parsing (various operators like ~=, !=, multi-char names) are under-tested; (4) --strict flag behavior, exit codes (0/1/2), and CLI argument validation are untested; (5) end-to-end test only covers package.json, not requirements.txt; (6) manifest detection doesn't test preference order or behavior when both files exist; (7) temporary directories created in tests are not cleaned up. The test suite would catch basic functionality regressions but would completely miss CLI bugs, workflow issues, and integration failures that would only surface in the CI/CD pipeline.
